name: browser-use
headline: MyConvergio - Enterprise AI Agent Ecosystem
short_description: MyConvergio is an enterprise AI agent ecosystem with 40 Claude Code subagents for strategic leadership, tech architecture, and organizational transformation. It benefits operations teams by automating complex workflows and integrating with Claude 4.5. The ecosystem connects to various business tools and workflows, enhancing productivity and decision-making.
author: Roberdan

sections.overview:
dotclaude is an AI agent orchestration framework that manages complex multi-agent workflows across distributed nodes using Rust, SQLite, and Bash. It provides independent validation through Thor's 10-gate system, file isolation via worktrees, and automated merge workflows. The mesh system uses CRDT synchronization for real-time state consistency across peers, with an HTTP API and WebSocket brain stream for observability. Teams use dotclaude to coordinate Claude Code agents on architecture decisions, code generation, and infrastructure tasks while enforcing quality standards through automated validation and learning loops.
Orchestrating multiple Claude Code agents across distributed team environments
Enforcing code quality and compliance gates before merging task outputs
Managing concurrent AI-driven development workflows with file locking and wave isolation
Real-time monitoring of agent execution via mesh dashboard and WebSocket streams
sections.setup:
